title: Distance under the balanced lift
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, let $i$ be a coordinate of the sign cube of dimension $n+1$, and choose whether to negate the dictator on coordinate $i$. The relative Hamming distance from the balanced lift of $f$ to that signed dictator equals the relative Hamming distance from $f$ to the function obtained by evaluating the signed dictator at the input formed by adjoining the sign $+1$ as its first coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
A choice of whether to negate the dictator
